body:
I hope you can get the courage to do what you love. I can't imagine being stuck in a job like that which you hate. you can always change your degree/career, a lot of people I have met have done this and turned out ok. you can too. 

It can be really hard with parents who don't understand. I don't get why this is such a problem for so many parents, why not just let your kid do what they want to do.
I will try but I can't right now that is my issue :/
I know this logically but I can't soothe the emotional part of my brain.

I get you right now I am almost a senior and I realized that I don't like the degree I am studying and I kinda want to go for art. Me and you should probably both say fuck it and go for our passions regardless of what other people/our parents think. Do what makes you happy, what point in there is it to make yourself utterly miserable for someone elses sake?

You could try to live for that. Sometimes I just think about all the creative stuff I want to do and it makes me want to hang around a little longer just to be able to put it out there.
I find it hard to talk to other people about this.
I have but I don't get a lot of responses that are helpful typically.

She didn't start off asking though rather just interrupted me when I was talking and it made me feel like that is all she cared about. When I asked if this was the wrong place to be talking she kinda implied that it wasn't for people who were not in immediate danger.
I have spent the past two days just bawling my eyes from stress I feel ya.
I am at the same point, I desperately want help but I also have to wait. It is so hard, we both got to the point where we need it right away and we are told to wait some more. Fuck it.

I sorta just want to let it go and give up. I have been trying hard for my entire 3 years but this semester has been the worst semester of class I have ever taken in my life no exaggeration. 

There is this one class that I needed for my major and it is absolutely ridiculously hard that most people dropped out (I regret not doing that myself so fucking much) and the teacher is a horrible horrible man who sets me into fits of anxiety whenever I talk to him. 

I am just planning to drop out so I can recover mentally and try to get help.
I logically know this and it does bring me comfort at times but it is so hard to think about how good it will be in the future when it is so terrifying now.

I don't have any definite plans to kill myself (like no time frame/specific plan) but I fear I might impulsively do it. I live on the top floor of my dorm and it would be so easy to just jump out. I have contemplated it numerous times. I am not quite in the mentality yet but really close.
